-Fixed a bug where you couldn't get out if you entered a broken building located on stage 10.

-Fixed a bug that some pants equipment had incorrect animation in multiple specific H scenes.

-Adjusted the shaking of the chest when equipping "Spirit Armor"
-Fixed a bug that CG including elements for adults may be displayed in the event scene in R-15 mode & changed the display contents
-Fixed a bug that a part of the bra was cut off and displayed when half off while wearing "Mofumofu Miniskirt (Santa Clothes)".
-Added "Eris does not attack enemies" to 04_Troubleshooting.txt
